purpose: Preserve reflection, diagnostic debate, closed SourceRequest routing, LCR/LC, and payback ownership.
rules: Capture actor-authored completion reflection and durable registered learning triggers.
Commit peer-masked diagnostic openings before reveal and preserve every response and dissent.
Map diagnosis, completion reflection, and recognized insight only to LC01; map post-LR4 payback only to LC02.
The source owns SourceRequest, the observer owns PaybackObservation, LCR owns admission, and LC owns mutation.
Only LR03-origin LC01 terminal recovery may return to LR; direct LC01 and all LC02 failures never reopen LR.
